estimand: route-wide count of independent original-clear-scene groups under a fixed 1,587-ITS plus 1,587-OTS allocation; the scientific contract separately freezes the stricter per-stratum simultaneous design
source_reference: The archived pilot planning SD is 0.444218872067388 dB. The schema base calculation is 1,213 groups. The route analyzes 3,174 independent scenes under a fixed nonpoolable allocation of 1,587 ITS and 1,587 OTS. The scientific contract adds the stricter Bonferroni requirement of 1,587 per stratum without changing the 0.025 dB target; the eligible capacities are 8,813 ITS and 8,006 OTS.
